body:
- mlx: match publisher tokenizer semantics

Honor pretokenizer stage order, split behavior, Unicode boundaries,

added-token normalization, and ranked BPE merges. Handle empty added

tokens and empty Metaspace input consistently.

Add shared Go/Python reference cases using published tokenizers, pulling

missing models directly and failing on errors, plus focused regressions

for configuration precedence, byte fallback, and parallel encoding.
summaryZh: Ollama v0.40.0-rc1 版本重点优化了 MLX 引擎的分词器处理逻辑。通过严格对齐发布者分词器语义，该版本在预分词阶段顺序、Unicode 边界处理、添加标记（added-token）归一化以及 BPE 合并规则等方面实现了更一致的行为。此外，更新引入了共享的 Go/Python 参考测试用例，并针对配置优先级、字节回退及并行编码进行了回归测试，显著增强了模型在不同环境下的推理一致性与稳定性。
